entities.summary: Khalid Iqbal Yasir born on 13 March 1952, is an author, scholar, poet, and journalist. He has written several books on history, general knowledge, critics and poetry. Currently working as advisor at Punjab Public Service Commission, consultant at UNDP and visiting professor at AIOU, Islamabad.
